caption: Favignana harbor, Egadi Islands
composition: Limestone harbor and tonnara waterfront · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is across the harbor mouth at first light, looking along Favignana's stone waterfront. The weathered arches of the old tonnara building anchor the left of the frame, pastel houses in pink, cream, and ochre run along the quay to the right, and a dark mountain silhouette rises behind the town. The modelled 23 September 2026, 06:20 dawn paints thin pink streaks across a pale blue sky, while the harbor lamps still burn and their reflections shiver on the calm dark water.
